app.tagline: 80+ AI models in Cursor, paid per call from your own wallet
status.unregistered: Wallet not registered with the server yet
wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.topup: Send USDC on **Base** to this address. Base only: USDC sent on any other chain (Ethereum, Arc, BSC…) will not arrive. No ETH needed.
wallet.backup: The private key stays on this PC (encrypted by Windows) and is never uploaded. Export a backup before changing PCs or reinstalling Windows.
wallet.toTopup: No USDC yet? Get Binance or OKX in one click on the Top up page, buy there and withdraw to this address (**Base network**).
x.ready: Downloaded and signature checked ({signer}); the installer is open
x.failed: Download failed: {error}. If the exchange is blocked on your network, turn on your proxy (Arm AI uses the system proxy) or use the official download page in your browser.
x.badsig: Wrong digital signature ({signer}); the file was deleted. Do not install it.
x.binance.facts: Withdrawing on Base: fee about **0.2 USDC**, minimum **3 USDC**. Crypto bought on P2P with CNY can be **withdrawn at once up to the equivalent of $2,000**.
x.binance.s1: After installing, sign up, complete **identity verification (KYC)** and turn on **Google Authenticator** under Security: P2P buying and withdrawals need it.
x.binance.s2: Buy **USDC** under Buy Crypto, or buy USDT and swap it to USDC with Convert.
x.binance.s3: Assets → Withdraw, pick **USDC**, paste the address from the Wallet page, network **Base** (not BSC / Ethereum / Arc: those never arrive).
x.binance.s4: Confirm with the authenticator code and the email / SMS code; it usually arrives in 1–2 minutes and the balance refreshes by itself. Try 3 USDC first.
x.binance.hold: Limits: P2P purchases above $2,000 equivalent are held 24 h; changing the password / authenticator locks withdrawals for 24 h; risk checks can lock them for 48 h.
x.okx.facts: Withdrawing on Base: fee about **0.02 USDC** (cheapest), minimum **2 USDC**. But crypto bought on P2P **may be held for days**.
x.okx.s1: After installing, sign up, complete **identity verification (KYC)** and turn on **Google Authenticator** (withdrawals need it); pay only from an account in your own name.
x.okx.s2: Buy **USDC** under Buy / P2P, or buy USDT and swap it to USDC with Convert.
x.okx.s3: Assets → Withdraw, pick **USDC**, paste the address from the Wallet page, network **Base**.
x.okx.s4: Confirm with the authenticator code and the email / SMS code; it usually arrives in 1–2 minutes. Try 2 USDC first.
x.okx.hold: Limits: P2P buys may trigger the T+N hold, no withdrawals for 3, 7 or 15 days (the order page shows how long; cancel and pick another order to avoid it). In a hurry, use Binance.
x.safety: Installers come only from the exchanges' official addresses, are saved to Downloads, and open only if the Windows signature is Binance's / OKX's own. Exchange accounts are separate: your account and money there are out of Arm AI's reach.
wallet.exportWarn: The private key controls all funds in this wallet. Only use it to back up or import into another wallet, and never send it to anyone (us included). Show it?
cursor.title: Use it in Cursor
cursor.none: Cursor was not found. Install it, then click "Search again".
cursor.step1: Turn on "OpenAI API Key" and paste the API Key below
cursor.step2: Turn on "Override OpenAI Base URL" and paste the Base URL below
cursor.step3: Click "Add model" and enter a model name, e.g. {examples}
cursor.step4: Pick it in the chat's model list. Keep Arm AI open while you use it.
cursor.note: While Override is on, Cursor's own GPT models also go to this address; switch it off when you don't need it.
cursor.test: Test the connection (free model, costs nothing)
cline.title: Use Cline (VS Code / Cursor / Kiro)
cline.why: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent (Apache-2.0). Inside your editor it works much like Cursor's Agent, and its requests go straight through Arm AI. No Cursor subscription needed: Cursor's new Free and Plus plans don't allow your own key, but Cline works there; VS Code doesn't even need an account.
cline.none: No VS Code / Cursor / Kiro found. Install VS Code (free), then click Rescan.
cline.done: Installed. Restart this editor to use it.
cline.configTitle: Set up Cline in one click
cline.stateOtherKey: Cline points at Arm AI but not with this PC's key. Click Write to update it.
cline.stateNone: Cline is not set up for Arm AI yet
cline.closeFirst: Close every editor that has Cline before writing (a running Cline writes its old settings back), then reopen it.
cline.written: Written. Your previous settings are backed up as ~/.cline/data/*.bak-armai.
cline.step1: Open the editor and click the Cline icon on the left (or Ctrl+Shift+P → Cline: Open In New Tab)
cline.step2: Type a task, e.g. "write a README for this project". Ignore Cline's own sign-in / sign-up
cline.step3: To switch models: pick one here and click Write again (editors closed), or change Model ID in Cline's settings
cline.cost: Cline sends one request per step (read a file, edit a file, run a command); with Claude each step costs at least about $0.03. To try it for free, use the model nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b (a free BlockRun model that may go away at any time). Keep Arm AI open while you use it.
caps.title: Spending caps
caps.why: Arm AI checks every payment on your PC: it only signs if the payee is BlockRun and the amount is within these caps.
log.title: History
log.mismatch: Served by a different model than requested
models.title: Models and prices
models.search: Search models, e.g. claude, deepseek, free
settings.title: Settings
settings.background: Closing this window keeps Arm AI running in the background and signing payments; double-click ArmAI.exe to open it again. To stop it completely, use the button below.
settings.quitConfirm: After quitting, the paid models in Cursor stop working until you open Arm AI again. Quit?
settings.quitDone: Arm AI has quit. You can close this window.
fee.title: Service fee
fee.why: Arm AI charges a 5% service fee on top of BlockRun's price: the server adds up what BlockRun actually charged and settles it from your wallet once it reaches $1 (we pay the on-chain gas). Arm AI keeps its own count and never signs more than 5% of what it signed to BlockRun on this PC; the fee address is fixed in the app.
fee.line: Settled {paid} · settling {pending} · still payable by this app's count {room}
fee.server: Unpaid by the server's count: {owed} (settled automatically at {settle})
footer.note: Your key is never uploaded; the server only relays requests and quotes, and Arm AI on your PC signs each payment.
